svg.title: FastRider · 2px margin, large zones, expanded power plot · v0.3.2
svg.desc: Edge 840 246x322 design reference with illustrative sensor data. Primary values align left at x2/x126, baseline44. Heart and bolt align at bottom52. Zones use 28px; native radar corner remains clear. The chart has only an 18px range and clock header, no elapsed time or distance/ascent footer. Plot spans x4..242/y243..319. Tap cycles 3s/10s, All/LAP, 5m/20m/All independently.
